clips.title: The story
paras: Along the Barrens coast, Islen Waterseer receives the Shard of Water from a shaman who has faced corruption.

Shamans must understand balance, life, and preservation to master water. In the Call of Water, they travel to corrupted springs, even crossing the sea to blighted Silverpine Forest. After purifying the tainted waters, a shaman receives the Shard of Water. Returning the crystal token to Islen Waterseer on the rocky Barrens shore proves the initiate's worth and provides the final key to forge a Water Totem.
